description: This file is a configuration script for Cypress, a JavaScript-based testing framework. It defines default behaviors for server responses and cookie handling to customize testing behavior.

methods.name: Cypress.Server.defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for Cypress server responses, such as delay and whitelisted XHRs.

methods.name: Cypress.Cookies.defaults
methods.description: Sets default cookie handling options, such as whitelisted cookies.
